dct_title_s: Lake Harriet, suggestive plan for the widening of the west shore boulevard and the location of a boat house for the storage of private canoes, Minneapolis, Minnesota
dct_description_sm: A suggested plan to widen the boulevard on the west shore of Lake Harriet and for a boat house to store private canoes in Minneapolis, Minnesota. The plan is found in the Thirtieth Annual Report of the Board of Park Commissioners of the City of Minneapolis, after page 102.
